news.headline: Delcath Q3 2026: revenue up 70% to $35.1M, net income $7.0M; FY2026 guidance raised to $115M-$117M
news.summary: Q3 revenue rose to $35.1M from $20.6M (HEPZATO KIT $32.7M, CHEMOSAT $2.4M), well above the ~$26M consensus, with 89% gross margin, net income of $7.0M ($0.17 diluted EPS) and adjusted EBITDA of $11.5M; cash and investments reached $104.3M with no debt. FY2026 revenue guidance was raised to $115M-$117M from $104M-$108M, with HEPZATO volume growth of at least 41%, Q3 HEPZATO volume up about 72% and 33 active treatment centers.

news.headline: BTIG keeps Buy on Delcath and raises price target to $25 from $21
news.summary: BTIG reiterated its Buy rating and lifted its target to $25 after the Q3 beat and guidance raise. Shares traded higher on the day following the results.

news.headline: Delcath to Participate in UBS, Canaccord Genuity and Craig-Hallum Investor Conferences in November
news.summary: Management will attend the UBS Global Healthcare Conference (November 10, Palm Beach Gardens, with a live webcast), the Canaccord Genuity MedTech, Diagnostics and Digital Health Forum (November 11, New York) and the Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference (November 17, New York). The appearances follow directly on the November 9 Q3 report, giving management an immediate platform to discuss results and guidance.

news.headline: BlackRock Reports 6.3% Passive Stake in Delcath (Schedule 13G)
news.summary: BlackRock Portfolio Management reported beneficial ownership of 2,180,493 Delcath shares, or 6.3% of the class as of September 30, 2026. That is up from the 1,836,121 shares (5.3%) BlackRock disclosed in July, so a large passive holder kept adding during the Q3 pullback.

news.headline: Delcath Highlights ESMO 2026 Presentations (DELUMA, mCRC Update) and Independent Uveal Melanoma Data
news.summary: Delcath will show a DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 trial-in-progress poster and host a 'Meet the Investigators' session on the Del-Liver mCRC and DELUMA trials at ESMO in Madrid on October 24, alongside an independent Dutch registry poster comparing PHP plus ipilimumab/nivolumab with tebentafusp. A separate independent Southampton/Dublin CHEMOSAT cohort (n=12) in uveal melanoma reported a 66.7% response rate, 18.4-month median hepatic PFS and 28-month median OS.

news.headline: Nebraska Medicine Begins Offering HEPZATO Liver-Directed Therapy for Metastatic Uveal Melanoma
news.summary: Local coverage reports that Nebraska Medicine in Omaha now offers the new liver-directed treatment for patients whose eye cancer (uveal melanoma) has spread to the liver. It adds another academic center in the Midwest to the HEPZATO KIT network that Delcath aims to expand to about 37 active sites by year-end.

catalysts.label: UBS Global Healthcare Conference presentation (webcast)
catalysts.detail: Management presents at UBS on November 10 in Palm Beach Gardens, the day after the Q3 beat, followed by the Canaccord Genuity forum on November 11 and Craig-Hallum Alpha Select on November 17 in New York. These are the first venues for follow-up color on the raised $115M-$117M guide, center activations and the mCRC/DELUMA trials.

catalysts.label: ~37 active HEPZATO treatment centers by year-end (33 active now)
catalysts.detail: Delcath reported 33 active HEPZATO KIT treatment centers with its Q3 results, up from 31 at the end of Q2, against an earlier goal of roughly 37 by year-end. Named additions in the pipeline include MD Anderson, Mayo Clinic Scottsdale, UT Southwestern, OHSU Knight Cancer Institute and Columbia; center count remains the most direct driver of near-term revenue.

catalysts.label: FY2026 results vs raised $115M-$117M guide and positive adjusted EBITDA
catalysts.detail: On November 9 Delcath raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $115M-$117M (from $104M-$108M), with HEPZATO volume growth of at least 41% over 2025, gross margin of 87%-89% and positive adjusted EBITDA. Nine-month revenue was $89.2M, implying roughly $26M-$28M for Q4; the FY report and the first 2027 outlook are due in early 2027.

catalysts.label: Cholangiocarcinoma IND submission
catalysts.detail: The Q3 release lists a planned IND submission for HEPZATO in cholangiocarcinoma in early 2027, plus completion of preclinical development of an oxaliplatin-based PHP product by mid-2027, pending FDA agreement. Both would broaden the liver-directed platform beyond uveal melanoma, mCRC and breast cancer.

catalysts.label: mCRC Phase 2 enrollment progress
catalysts.detail: The company-sponsored Phase 2 of HEPZATO plus trifluridine-tipiracil and bevacizumab versus that regimen alone in third-line liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer had 13 centers actively screening as of the Q2 call, with recruitment improving. Enrollment milestones and eventual data would open by far the largest indication in the pipeline, since liver-dominant mCRC dwarfs uveal melanoma in patient numbers.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 enrollment and data
catalysts.detail: The roughly 90-patient randomized Phase 2 in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (PHP-MBC-202, NCT06875128) dosed its first patient in July 2026 at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan and is enrolling across more than 20 US and European sites. Investigator-led retrospective data presented at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 showed a 60% hepatic partial response rate in heavily pretreated patients, which underpins the trial's thesis. The primary endpoint is hepatic progression-free survival; full enrollment and first efficacy readouts are the next major pipeline catalysts beyond uveal melanoma.

pulse: Delcath delivered a clear beat on November 9: Q3 revenue rose 70% to $35.1M (vs ~$26M consensus) with 89% gross margin, $7.0M net income, $11.5M adjusted EBITDA and $104.3M of cash with no debt, and FY2026 guidance was raised to $115M-$117M from $104M-$108M. Shares rose on the print from around $14 and BTIG lifted its target to $25, as HEPZATO volume grew about 72% with 33 active centers. Next come the UBS (Nov 10), Canaccord (Nov 11) and Craig-Hallum (Nov 17) appearances, further center activations toward year-end, mCRC and DELUMA trial enrollment and a planned cholangiocarcinoma IND in early 2027.
